records.requirementOrFinding: Keen runs at 70Hz with fixed integer tics (clamped 2–5 per frame) and fixed-point positions (256 units = 1 tile = 16px, so 16 units = 1px). Omnispeak (the modern port) keeps exactly this and it is why Keen physics survives on a 144Hz monitor.
